services.name: calendar and rentals
services.desc: We are currently fully booked for 2026. If you are interested in renting Kanon’s front gallery space in 2027, we would love to hear from you. Kanon is part of Lakewood’s 40 West Arts District and is located in our new space at The Hub at 40 West Arts. Each exhibition runs for a full month and includes a First Friday opening reception. During your show, Kanon will staff the gallery during regular open hours, handle all artwork sales, and promote your exhibition through our email list, social media, and website.
